eligible_direct_quotes.note: A and (B or C) becomes two filters: an all-filter then an any-filter.

premium_rate_and_instalment.note: nested expressions replace the four helper columns and their drop

capped_vehicle_exposure.note: nested expression: no helper column, so nothing to collide with a real column

log_claim_severity.note: log base 10 via natural log divided by ln(10)

underwriting_decision.note: a when-chain is built backwards, each branch overriding the column

typed_rating_export.reason: Enum categories are not a cast type (Categorical is); everything else in the snippet is expressible now, including the Int8 cast

floating_measure_summary.note: whole-frame summary with a dtype-selected mean

quotes_without_accepted_claims.note: the filtered claims frame is a separate upstream Transform node

quotes_with_large_open_claims.note: separate upstream node for the filtered claims

segment_benchmark_join.note: separate upstream node for the benchmark aggregation

combined_quote_review_queue.note: two upstream filter nodes feed a concat node

hierarchical_premium_imputation.note: coalesce chain as successive conditionals; whole-frame median is a window with no partition

regional_channel_pivot.note: fixed-column pivot step, lowered to a group-by

largest_claims_per_policy.note: top-N per group as row numbers after a sort, then a join back to the rows

vehicle_and_age_bands.reason: cut with cut points belongs to the Banding node; the age when-chain is expressible

top_regional_price_outliers.note: row numbers follow the preceding sort, as in the original
